result:
All 76 pass.

Root cause: `MemoryStore.decisions()` filtered on raw stored `status`, but `supersede()` never rewrote old record's status (append-only log), so old decision stayed `ACTIVE` forever — never reclassified, contrary to docstring. Also broke `check_decision_resurfacing`, which relies on `decisions(include_inactive=True)` status to find rejected/superseded items — superseded decisions were invisible to it.

Fix: `decisions()` now builds `supersedes` chain on read and overrides effective status to `SUPERSEDED` for any decision another record names as superseded. Single fix point, so resurfacing check inherits it automatically.

Added regression tests in both files exercising `store.supersede()` end-to-end.
